campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 1, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered a resolution authorizing an agreement with the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority for a Low Carbon Transportation and Operations Program fund related to transit reliability and performance improvements. The agenda also referenced pothole damage and related claims processes.
keyTopics: Resolution to authorize a Low Carbon Transportation and Operations Program fund agreement with VTA for a transit reliability improvement and performance systems project
Pothole damage and the claims process

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 2, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business including meeting minutes, check registers, and the Treasurer's Report, along with responses to two Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims processing and VTA's oversight of the BART Silicon Valley Phase II project. The Council also considered a state bill on utility data transparency, a transportation impact fee study contract, forming a committee on alternative policing services, the future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival, and the city's continued participation in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County.
keyTopics: Responses to Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole damage claims and VTA's management of BART Silicon Valley Phase II
Support for AB 1761, a bill on utility billing data transparency
An $85,000 contract with Fehr and Peers for a Transportation Impact Fee study
Forming an Ad-Hoc Committee to review alternative policing services
The future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival and continued involvement in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 8, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council reviewed routine business including updated pay schedules for city employee groups and a contract increase for electrical maintenance services, along with a resolution to rename Lee Street to Tubman Street. The Council also considered restructuring a volunteer awards committee, discussed the Environmental Commission, and took up a citizen-initiated report on potential zoning impacts.
keyTopics: Resolution renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Revised Fiscal Year 2026/27 pay schedules for employee associations and unrepresented staff
Contract amendment adding $250,000 to Bear Electrical Solutions' maintenance agreement
Disbanding the joint Los Altos-Los Altos Hills Volunteer Awards Committee to form a separate Los Altos committee
Citizen initiative presentation on potential impacts to zoning

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 1, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council met to approve routine meeting minutes and consider a handful of administrative items, including vacating a public service easement on Cerro Vista and setting up new parking rules in town. The Council also considered hiring a consultant to help with an executive-related matter.
keyTopics: Vacating a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista
Establishing preferential and time-limited parking permits in town
Authorizing a consultant agreement for executive-related services
Approval of minutes from several prior Council meetings held in August 2026

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 2, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole met to plan upcoming City Council schedules, canceling the September 8, 2026 meeting and reviewing the draft agenda for September 15, 2026. The committee also considered the City Clerk's public record log for late August and took up a study session on financing tools that could support economic development infrastructure projects.
keyTopics: Cancellation of the September 8, 2026 Council meeting
Review and possible additions to the September 15, 2026 draft agenda
Public record log covering August 20–27, 2026
Study session on infrastructure financing tools for economic development

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — September 8, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The City Council began with a closed session to discuss performance evaluations and labor negotiation matters concerning two unrepresented staff positions, the City Clerk and City Manager. The regular open session that followed included a proclamation recognizing National Hispanic Heritage Month.
keyTopics: Closed-session performance evaluation of the City Clerk and City Manager
Closed-session labor negotiations involving the City Clerk and City Manager, with Vice Mayor Clark designated as the negotiator
Proclamation recognizing National Hispanic Heritage Month

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 25, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council held a special meeting on August 25, 2026, beginning with a closed session followed by a public presentation. The presentation covered an update on the CleanWater Program.
keyTopics: Closed session (special meeting)
CleanWater Program update presentation

cupertino.title: Cupertino Teen Commission — September 9, 2026
cupertino.summary: Cupertino's Teen Commission kicked off its new term by swearing in incoming commissioners for 2026-2028 and holding an orientation session. The meeting also included a presentation on teen programs and approval of prior meeting minutes.
keyTopics: Swearing-in ceremony for incoming 2026-2028 Teen Commissioners
Teen Commission orientation
Presentation on teen programs
Approval of August 12, 2026 minutes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, with one Councilmember participating remotely from India. The agenda excerpt provided mainly covers logistical details about how the public could watch, join via Zoom, or submit written comments rather than substantive policy items.
keyTopics: Councilmember Chahal's remote participation from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format with in-person and Zoom remote access options
Procedures for submitting written public comment before the meeting

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 1, 2026
milpitas.summary: The City Council, sitting as the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency, considered routine financial and administrative business tied to winding down old redevelopment debt. This included confirming which city officials serve as agency officers and authorizing the sale of new bonds to refinance existing redevelopment debt.
keyTopics: Confirming and designating city officials as officers of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency
Authorizing issuance and sale of 2026 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds to refinance existing redevelopment debt

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Climate Action and Sustainability Committee — September 4, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Climate Action and Sustainability Committee looked at an early version of the city's 2025 greenhouse gas inventory, including a breakdown of Scope 3 emissions (indirect emissions from things like purchased goods and services). The committee also reviewed different approaches Palo Alto could take toward its carbon neutrality goal and gave staff feedback on what areas need more analysis.
keyTopics: Preliminary review of the 2025 greenhouse gas inventory
Overview of Scope 3 emissions
Approaches to achieving the city's carbon neutrality goal
Committee feedback on areas for further staff analysis
